Import all ShuttleSoft files in a directory

Source: R/read_shuttlesoft_project.R
read_shuttlesoft_project.Rd

Imports every ShuttleSoft .txt and .csv file in a directory and returns them as a named list. A metadata table is optional. When supplied, it may provide different trial start times or thermal-model values for each file.

Usage

read_shuttlesoft_project(metadata = NULL, directory = getwd(), prepare = TRUE)

Arguments

metadata

Optional data frame containing file_name and any of trial_start, mass, initial_T, a_value, or b_value.

directory

Directory containing the ShuttleSoft files. The default is the current working directory.

prepare

Logical. If TRUE (the default), prepare each file with file_prepare().

Value

A named list of imported ShuttleSoft data frames.

Details

Files are imported in alphabetical order. If metadata is supplied, values are matched to each file using the file_name column.

See also

read_shuttlesoft, calc_project_results
